fixtureRecipe: Seed public Core commands into factory-created marked temp Spaces. Note n-i body paragraph j = padded i/j + x to declared length. Task t-i is its own task page with one Details i paragraph, no subtasks. Active page is n-1. Initial version plus nine deterministic final-character changes for ten retained versions. Media bytes copied from hashed I1 fixtures; four-view trace uses two independent note contexts per active note. Seed outside timing, flush/reopen, pin fixture hash, archive any generation failure; no direct SQL/Y seed shortcut. Tables/full typed properties/inline assets from old W profiles are NOT represented by these paragraph profiles. Each active Space holds an authenticated client during multi-Space measurements; four views/two windows target the active note in Space1, background Spaces2/3 retain headless clients so idle exit does not remove their costs.

measurement.sequence: Pin/validate contract+host+versions+instrumentation, seed/hash fixture, correctness smoke, release builds, measured comparison, independent correctness/fault evidence. Do not infer correctness from timing success.
measurement.repeats: Existing budget method applies: 5 warmups,30 measured opens/catchups,1000 input samples over>=5 fresh sessions, nearest-rank quantiles; report raw samples and stalled/cancelled/failed attempts. Initial ready-machine cold runs:30 independent service/process cold launches; label OS-cache-warm, not disk-cache-cold.
measurement.order: Rotate candidates A/B/C per repetition; same thermal/power profile and local volume, no debugger/dev server; no privileged cache purge. Bad environment remains retained/excluded with reason before analysis.
measurement.startup: External monotonic start through authenticated first query OR first native-presented/editable document; record endpoints separately. Report first-ever install/recovery separately from ordinary cold and warm starts.
measurement.memory: Measure aggregate physical-footprint idle/peak/post-close plateau, plus process breakdown. Attribute or conservatively include system webview helpers/shared services; disclose double-count/shared-accounting method. Missing attribution cannot rank a candidate as free memory.
measurement.disk: Separate per-arch compressed signed distributable, full installed app/runtime/helper logical+allocated bytes, per-user service cache, and fixed fixture DB/WAL/journal/media. Report required OS webview/runtime dependencies; no source map/cache/fixture exclusions hidden.
measurement.comparison: Reject correctness failures first. Among candidates meeting fixed applicable thresholds, rank steady-state aggregate physical footprint, then actual native input p99, then cold GUI p95, then installed size. <=5% differences or uncertainty overlapping that band are ties; publish all tradeoffs. Existing code, migration effort and implementation effort have zero selection weight.
measurement.revisionRule: No post-result threshold/workload/candidate change without new version/reason and full comparable rerun; archive failures. No meaningful winner if mandatory metric missing.
